author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.74 shipped: Reserve write check reads the live Envoy reserve sensor
summary: Reserve write check reads the live Envoy reserve sensor
why: Operator asked 'why a new setting? What's the real problem'. The root-cause audit found the write verifier's local reserve witness, the Enpower number, has read only 10 since 2026-08-05 while the official Envoy reserve sensor tracks the real reserve (14 vs 10 on 10-12/13). That produced 2-7 false resends and 0-3 CRITICAL pages per day with 3 h stand-downs, and hid any real failure at 10. The fix swaps only the witness source inside the existing resolver, keeps the operator's +/-2 margin and the write path untouched. Plan-reviewed, three framing-disjoint reviews SHIP, 24-site mutation pass, full name-diff clean.
implications: Shipped EC-SELFHEAL-UNEXPLAINED-RESENDS-1 at v5.103.74; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.74.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Witness-unavailable trip-wire (pre-existing outage blind spot) folded onto the card as residual

refs.release_notes: The reserve write verifier's local witness was a number frozen at 10 since 08-05 (false resends + CRITICALs, masked failures at 10). It now prefers the official enphase_envoy reserve sensor via registry lookup, falls back only when unresolvable, abstains when unavailable. No new setting; tolerance unchanged.
